mechanisms: An armed answer that reaches a forward frame under a raider before it dies: armllt_1240, armmex_14554, armllt_600, armmex_1360 (127 metal; the report showed the raider within 340-760 of the standing frame each time; the hands' detachments were 1100 behind, ended by the leash, or sent after the kill, and the player's turns at 8:41 and 15:42 ordered nothing for the frame).

The list's taken-as-done step for an order not yet started, after which the next step replaces that order a second later (lists.rs: a list newer than the order stays 'ready'): never-started 3:17 spot_76 and 5:31 spot_59, no metal in frames but two extractors about 125 and 135 s late (about 260 extractor-seconds of income, on the order of 750 metal at the report's 3.0 a second an extractor: an estimate) and a turret built over no extractor at spot_59; fixed since e9f5175 (2026-10-16, Pianist::list_caught_up: 'the step waits for the frame').

A way back to the builder's own unfinished frame once a retreat's threat is gone: armmex_8605 and armllt_2190 (37 metal; 8605's menu offered no move to its 55% frame for 25 s while no enemy was in its picture); the same retreats cost the orders 2:40 spot_61 and 12:22 spot_46; still live at HEAD: menu.rs offers repair only for units not being built and help_<builder> only for a frame another builder's started task is on, so a frame nobody is on is on no builder's menu.
